# TechRepublic

> > TechRepublic delivers IT news, professional development, and technology insights for enterprise and business professionals.

TechRepublic is a leading resource for technology professionals seeking news, tutorials, and practical advice on enterprise IT, software development, and digital transformation. The site covers emerging technologies including AI, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity while offering educational courses and software deals through TechRepublic Academy.

## Key Topics

- AI agents
- Enterprise infrastructure
- Windows updates
- Nvidia
- Microsoft
- Open-source tools
- AI deployment
- Humanoid robots
- Security software
- Tech layoffs
- Productivity tools
- Software deals
- Cloud computing
- Cryptocurrency
- Lifetime licenses

## Core Resources

- [TechRepublic Homepage](https://www.techrepublic.com): TechRepublic homepage: IT news, tips, and community advice for technology professionals
- [TechRepublic Academy](https://academy.techrepublic.com): Software deals, courses, bundles, and giveaways for IT professionals including lifetime licenses and discount offers
